parts.text: There is a large blast, a flash of blue energy and sparks shoot out of the back of the weapon. The force actually lifts Percy off the ground for a second.
Matthew Mercer introduces himself and the concept of Critical Role. The introduction videos for Grog, Keyleth, Percy, Scanlan, Tiberius, Vax'ildan, and Vex'ahlia are shown.
Keyleth casts fog over the ring and also runs in. She casts Polymorph on Trinket, turning him into a rat, throws him to Scanlan, and then shifts into a bear herself.
Grog says "I got my money on Ballsack." Scanlan is offended that Grog would bet on the enemy.
The tavern owner, Adra, appreciates his generosity. Scanlan inquires about some rooms for the night.
